Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the stomachache, add a physical reaction to make the pain vivid: “他疼得在地上打滚。”
2. When describing the helpful plants, add how his body feels: “吃了以后，他觉得身体轻松多了。”
3. Add a short inner thought after he notices the different results: “他想：哪些植物能吃，哪些不能吃呢？”

ideas.reason: This gives a concrete physical reaction that fits his severe stomach pain.
This makes the general idea of feeling comfortable more specific in simple Chinese.
This simple thought fits his discovery that different plants have different effects.
